fields.title: Antigravity CLI executable
fields.description: Path to the official agy binary. Leave as agy to auto-detect on PATH and standard install locations.

fields.title: Idle worker timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long to keep an idle agy worker process running before shelving its conversation for resume.

fields.title: Allow AI credits
fields.description: Enable Google One AI credits overage (useG1Credits) in the isolated agy configuration after regular quota runs out.

fields.title: Request timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time for ACP setup or for an agy sampling round to start producing output or requesting tools.
